text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning from an outing with Curren 
Chan—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah, Curren! Come check out my new magic!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, welcome back, Curren. The place 
really brightens up when you're around.

text_block_list.name: Janitor Mister
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Curren-chan. Today's 
UmaStagram photo was super cute, too!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, welcome back, Curren-chan. Would you 
like to try some samples of our new 
product?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Curren Chan exchanged greetings with 
people from all across the Academy. When 
on earth did she make this many 
acquaintances...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Curren's gotten close with so many 
people at the academy~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Still, maybe it's not quite enough?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainerrr!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm sorry to interrupt your 
conversation, but there was an error in 
the documents I handed out the other day—
choice_data_list:
Did you come all the way here just to 
deliver that?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I apologize for the trouble, but 
could you please sign your name once more? 
Would you happen to have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm-hmm~.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that's all of the corrections. 
Thank you for your cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh? Where is your trainee, Curren 
Chan-san...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Curren's here♪ Are you two done 
talking about work~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: In that case, please have some sweets~♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Curren Chan brought over was a plate 
of freshly made, deliciously fragrant mini 
pancakes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's a new sweet that the cafeteria lady 
gave me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...I just thought you might want 
something sweet when you're tired from 
working so hard."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh my, what a sweet gesture...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much. Please let me 
repay you sometime.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren wants to go to a dessert buffet!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Come to think of it, there was a 
place I've been curious about as well—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I made a promise to go to a buffet 
with Tazuna-san~♪
choice_data_list: We made another friend, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Curren Chan has been steadily 
befriending not only the students, but 
also the academy staff. Just why is she—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hey... Are you curious why Curren 
wants to get along with everyone at the 
academy?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's obvious even if you try to hide it, 
you know? If you want to find out, why 
don't you follow Curren?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Where we arrived was the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You know, here's what Curren thinks.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you make friends with all kinds of 
people, you'll be able to do all kinds of 
things. And then, you seeâ

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make friends with even more people, 
and then I can do so much more of what I 
want!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Onii-chan. Curren wants to be 
able to do even more things. Because if I 
do, then..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Onee-chan. Curren wants to be 
able to do even more things. Because if I 
do, then..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She knew exactly what it took to 
accomplish something great. Ah, which 
means that she is—
choice_data_list: And you want to become even cuter, huh.
And you want to become even cuter, right.

Are you trying to take over the academy... 
!?

Are you planning to take over the 
academy...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She knew exactly what it took to 
accomplish something great. Ah, which 
means that she is—
choice_data_list: And you want to become even cuter, huh.
And you want to become even cuter, right.

Are you trying to take over the academy... 
!?

Are you planning to take over the 
academy...!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehe, corre~ct.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, remember this much. Even if you 
make lots of friends and can do more 
things—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Without you, I wouldn't be able to do 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because the reason Curren can run in the 
Twinkle Series is all thanks to you, Big 
Brother."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because the reason Curren can run in the 
Twinkle Series is all thanks to you, Big 
Sister."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're the first one, Big Brother. And 
that's never going to change.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're my first, Big Sis. That will never, 
ever change.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So please stay good friends with Curren, 
okay? ...Big Brother♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So please stay good friends with Curren, 
okay? ...Big Sister♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—There was only one answer to that 
question."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whaat, that's not true~! Don't make Curren 
sound like a bad girl~! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren just wants help from lots of people 
so I can do even cuter things, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Curren isn't— going to be 
satisfied with just the academy, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I just heard something 
outrageous...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as she said herself earlier, 
Curren Chan surely isn't a 'bad girl.' She 
simply wants 'everyone's cooperation.'"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I wonder what I should do next~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Probably.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're so funny, Big Bro☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're so funny, Big Sis☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, that might be a bit 
different, don't you think? Because Curren 
is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The cutest in the universe, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly! Let's do our best, yeah♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Curren Chan could surely dye even the 
cosmos in cuteness. Was it mere favoritism 
that made me think so?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Big Brother. The person Curren 
wants to be friends with next is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Big Sister. The person Curren 
wants to be friends with next is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—As Curren Chan spoke, her eyes sparkled, 
brimming with absolute confidence.
